name: boring-ui-macos-desktop
description: Private Electron host for the Boring UI macOS application.

scripts.package: pnpm run build:full && node scripts/forge-staged.mjs package
scripts.make:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:full && node scripts/forge-staged.mjs make --platform=darwin --arch=arm64
scripts.make:mac:x64: pnpm run build:full && node scripts/forge-staged.mjs make --platform=darwin --arch=x64
